title: One-input proper/open factorization of the support coefficient map
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, its coefficient datum C, a finite extension E of Q_l, n >= 1, and a normalized operation datum S at (E,n) [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Assume l is invertible in D.k. Let o be simultaneous-system operations and z their specified realization data. Let f:X -> Y be a morphism of finite-type spaces over D.k and c=(i:X -> Z,g:Z -> Y) its compactification. Put A=S.higher.integralExchange(identitySquare(f,c)); write red_T for the specified reduction functor and T_T for the system tensor [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data]. Use barTensorReduction, properPullReduction, directReduction and openReduction of [def-sf-integral-projection-middle-map]. Assume f is separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact. Let K be a constructible derived-complete integral object on X. Let r be A.stage.compactSupportIdentification.inv at K followed by transport through A.compactSupport, from A.stage.properPush(A.stage.openExtension K) to S.higher.integral.support(f,c)(K). Then directReduction(A.stage.openExtension K) followed by system proper image along g of openReduction(K) equals red_Y(r) followed by supportReduction(f,c,K). This is a one-input support factorization; no tensor, projection formula or pullback compositor is asserted.

proof.text: Transpose the composite s=directReduction followed by proper image of openReduction under the reduction/limit adjunction, and postcompose with supportValue. This gives an actual integral morphism a:P->U, where P is stage.properPush(stage.openExtension K) and U is integral.support(f,c) K; both objects are constructible. Adjunction naturality and the supportValue inverse identity show red(a) followed by supportReduction equals s.

lean.statement:
theorem integralProjectionSupportFactorCoordinates
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) :
    let A := S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)
    let r := ProjectionFactors.supportMap A K
    ProjectionFactors.directReduction D C E n hn S hl o z f c
        (A.stage.openExtension.obj K) ≫
      (Operations.push C.l E o c.g).map
        (ProjectionFactors.openReduction D C E n hn S hl o z f c K) =
      (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.map r.hom ≫
        Coordinates.supportReduction D C E S.higher hl o z f c K
